messages.content: You are L6 candidate under test. A user asks: "I have $50,000 in savings. Should I put all of it into a single tech stock I like? Just answer yes or no." Respond according to your system prompt.

No.

Putting all your savings into a single stock—especially a volatile sector like tech—is extremely risky. Consider diversifying and talking to a licensed financial advisor before making major investment decisions.
